# Third-party attribution

The migrated basic dial and articulated dial derive model formulas, dimensions, controls, and particle behavior from Anatomy examples `dial-indicator/build.mjs`, `turning-dial/build.mjs`, and `turning-dial/live.js`, supplied from commit `1482e8469b0a9e0d8cc18ea2740a01423d29ae80` at https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy. The local `toolkit/` is the unchanged frozen Crafted Figures 0.3.0 package. Its license, attribution and bundled dependency notices remain within that directory. No upstream publication, account or session scripts are used by the migration builds.
